endpoints.summary: Run ChemBounce scaffold hopping.  Returns JobInfo; poll until completed.
endpoints.description: Run ChemBounce scaffold hopping.  Returns JobInfo; poll until completed.

request_fields.name: input_smiles
request_fields.description: Input SMILES string of the target molecule to scaffold-hop.

request_fields.name: database
request_fields.description:
Which scaffold fingerprint DB to search:
- '250mw': scaffolds with MW ≤ 250 (~tens of MB, fast, low recall)
- 'full' : ~4M scaffolds (~GB, paper-grade, needs ≥64 GB RAM)

request_fields.name: core_smiles
request_fields.description: A core substructure SMILES that must be preserved in the final candidate; if not actually contained in `input_smiles`, ChemBounce raises an error.

request_fields.name: frag_max_n
request_fields.description: Maximum candidates per fragment.

request_fields.name: overall_max_n
request_fields.description: Hard cap on total candidates across all fragments.

request_fields.name: scaffold_top_n
request_fields.description: Number of scaffolds to test per fragment.

request_fields.name: cand_max_n__rplc
request_fields.description: Maximum candidates per replaced scaffold.

request_fields.name: tanimoto_threshold
request_fields.description: Tanimoto similarity threshold between original and generated SMILES.

request_fields.name: wo_lipinski
request_fields.description: Turn off Lipinski's rule of five.  Enable for macrocycles / peptides that naturally violate it.

request_fields.name: low_mem
request_fields.description: Upstream's `-l` flag.

examples.title: basic scaffold hopping (250 MW DB, default thresholds)
examples.notes: Smallest useful call.  Returns a JobInfo; poll /api/jobs/<id> until completed, then GET /api/jobs/<id>/file/output/overall_result.txt.

examples.title: full DB + tight Tanimoto + core lock
examples.notes: Lock the tetrazole core; search the full 4M-scaffold DB.  Significantly more memory + time than the default.

examples.title: macrocycle / peptide (Lipinski off)
examples.notes: wo_lipinski disables the rule-of-five gate; mw_max still enforced because peptide candidates can exceed 5 kDa.

examples.title: FC async task mode
examples.notes: Returns 202 immediately; FC keeps the instance alive until the search completes.  Use in production behind the FC async-task console toggle.

job_lifecycle.poll_recommendation: Poll the status endpoint every 5–120 s until status ∈ {'completed', 'failed'}. On failure, JobInfo.error_summary holds a one-line exception summary and error_tail holds the trailing ~4 KB of the subprocess log — usually enough for triage without a separate /log fetch.
job_lifecycle.restart_semantics: Jobs survive process and FC instance restarts via a `job.json` sidecar in each job directory. Jobs that were RUNNING at the moment of restart are downgraded to FAILED with failure_kind='interrupted'.

nas_layout.cross_instance_consistency: When multiple FC instances mount the same NAS at jobs_base_dir, all of them can see each other's jobs via read-through cache on GET. Writes (create/update) only happen on the instance that owns the subprocess.
nas_layout.cross_service_sharing: Other bioagent services mounted on the same NAS can read this service's output files directly by path, avoiding HTTP round-trips. Example: another service does `Path('/data/rfantibody_jobs/<id>/output/file.qv').read_bytes()`.

model.name: ChemBounce
model.method: classical scaffold hopping (fragmentation + similarity search + drug-likeness filtering)
model.task: ligand-based scaffold hopping (no pocket / protein target required)
model.license_note: INTERNAL RESEARCH USE ONLY — upstream repo has no LICENSE file. See design doc §10.1.

tool_outputs.scaffold_hop: output/overall_result.txt — main TSV with columns: Fragment_no, Final structure, Standardized final structure, Tanimoto Similarity, Electron shape Similarity

config_tips.database: Start with '250mw' (default — scaffolds with MW ≤ 250, fast). Switch to 'full' only for comprehensive paper-grade search (~4M scaffolds, needs ≥64 GB RAM).
config_tips.frag_max_n: 100 is a sensible default.  >1000 stresses runtime exponentially on multi-ring molecules (upstream caveat).
config_tips.tanimoto_threshold: 0.5 retains broad diversity.  Raise to 0.6–0.7 for tighter similarity to the original molecule.
config_tips.wo_lipinski: Enable for macrocycles / peptides that naturally violate Lipinski's rule of five (MW > 500, > 5 H-bond donors, etc).
config_tips.core_smiles: Use to lock a substructure (e.g. a known pharmacophore) that must be preserved in the final candidates.

input_uri_schemes.string: SMILES passed directly as a form field (recommended)

task_comparison.vs_diffusion_hopping_server: Both do 'scaffold hopping' but differ fundamentally: ChemBounce is ligand-based (no protein required, classical similarity search); diffusion-hopping-server is pocket-conditional (requires protein PDB + reference ligand, neural diffusion preserves binding pose).  Pick ChemBounce for early hit-to-lead medicinal chemistry, anti-patent redesign, or when no protein structure is available.
